explanation:
[EFFECT] Higher humidity (red dots) tends to sit on the negative side of the contribution axis, while low humidity (blue dots) is closer to zero, meaning wetter air is associated with reduced predicted demand. The effect is moderate in size, with most dots between about −0.5 and +0.1 and one extreme low-humidity outlier much further left.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the fifth most important feature, with a moderate spread comparable to month.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability and staffing — primarily on the hour of day and temperature, as these two features drive the vast majority of demand variation; ensure full availability during warm-weather daytime hours and scale back overnight and in cold conditions.
